rationale: The prompt requires Create a new Codex skill for a repeated workflow, including the SKILL.md structure, trigger description, and optional resources/scripts guidance. Do not install an existing skill or migrate settings; the anchored # Skill Creator explicitly scopes the source-visible workflow to Use when authoring a brand-new skill from scratch - turning a capability idea or a "make me a skill that…" request into a complete SKILL.md with a trigger-precise description and the full paid-quality anatomy: procedure. That scope directly supports the requested input, transformation, and deliverable rather than leaving a material component unaddressed.
